data.summary: Founding frontend engineer. Built the underwriting workbench behind the first major contract.

sections.title: Product delivery
sections.body: Owned the frontend from an inherited prototype through the company's first major contract. Delivered the underwriting workbench and multi-tenant feature configuration.

sections.title: Application foundations
sections.body: Migrated JavaScript to TypeScript and consolidated applications in a Turborepo monorepo. Replaced SASS and Carbon with Tailwind and headless Radix and React Aria components.

sections.title: Data access
sections.body: Introduced GraphQL code generation, schema stitching, and fragment-based data access to replace a monolithic query with load times above two minutes.

sections.title: Engineering leadership
sections.body: Established frontend standards and mentored engineers while retaining responsibility for client delivery.

data.about: I’m a full-stack engineer who likes getting to the bottom of a problem and building something useful from what I learn. I enjoy the whole process, from early experiments and architecture to the small details that make software feel good to use. I care about speed, clear code, and making complex things easier to work with. Building tools that help other people create keeps me curious.
